description:
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Dreamstone Hedron.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat.

uses.name: The Enigma Jewel // Locus of Enlightenment
